examples.title: Pull a key from an IBK clean plate
examples.code:
# Use a processed clean plate to drive the key.
ibk = nuke.createNode("IBKGizmo")
ibk.setInput(1, clean_plate)  # c
ibk.setInput(2, foreground)   # fg
ibk["st"].setValue("C-green")
